functionality.rationale: The lifecycle fixture currently makes make verify fail for the first real schema-v4 integrated task, blocking every governed acceptance.

security.rationale: The repair must preserve fail-closed criterion-evidence validation and must not fabricate acceptance evidence to close inherited fixture state.

performance.rationale: The fixture performs a bounded read of one delivery-parent record for each inherited integrated task.

compatibility.rationale: Legacy records and accepted schema-v4 records must continue to validate while an in-flight schema-v4 delivery no longer poisons the isolated fixture.

concurrency.rationale: The repair changes deterministic fixture preparation before any synthetic lifecycle process starts.

platform.rationale: The helper uses portable Python, JSON, and Git plumbing already required by the harness on every CI platform.

persistence.rationale: Fixture record rewriting must remain isolated and must restore exact durable parent content instead of manufacturing terminal provenance.

adr.rationale: The repair restores the accepted schema-v4 evidence contract and changes no public or expensive-to-reverse decision.

architecture.rationale: The change is confined to integration-test fixture preparation and introduces no production module or dependency.

roadmap.rationale: The repair unblocks engineering acceptance and adds no product behavior or milestone.

failure_fingerprints: FAILED: integrated schema-v4 lifecycle state is not isolated

defect.symptom: make verify fails inside governance_test.sh with 'criterion_evidence must be an object' while XT-093 is locally integrated.
defect.expected_contract: AGENTS.md requires make verify as the repository completion gate, and schema-v4 done records require exact-candidate criterion evidence generated only during acceptance.
defect.actual_behavior: The isolated lifecycle fixture changes every inherited integrated record to done and supplies no criterion_evidence, so governance validation rejects its synthetic repository.
defect.trigger: Run make governance-test or make verify from a standard squash delivery commit whose task record has schema_version 4 and state integrated.
defect.failure_fingerprint: FAILED: integrated schema-v4 lifecycle state is not isolated
